title: Should High School Students Have Part-Time Jobs?
topic: Some people think high school students should take part-time jobs. Others disagree. Write an essay of about 150 words stating your opinion with reasons.
content:
In my opinion, high school students should have part-time jobs. There are two reasons for this.

First, working part-time teaches students about money. When I worked at a coffee shop last summer, I learned how hard it is to earn one thousand dollars. After that experience, I stopped buying things I did not need. My classmates who never worked still spend money very fast, and they does not understand why their parents are tired.

Second, a part-time job helps students meet different people. At school we only talk to classmates who are the same age as us. At the coffee shop I talked to office workers, old people, and even foreign tourists. This made my English better and also made me more confident.

Of course, studying is still the most important thing. Students should not work too many hours. But a few hours on weekend is helpful, not harmful.
